steps.run: (() => { window.qaVisible = element => { if (!element || !element.checkVisibility({ checkOpacity: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) || element.closest('[inert]')) return false; const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return box.width > 0 && box.height > 0 && box.left >= 0 && box.top >= 0 && box.right <= innerWidth && box.bottom <= innerHeight && [[.5,.5],[.2,.2],[.8,.2],[.2,.8],[.8,.8]].every(([x,y]) => element.contains(document.elementFromPoint(box.left + box.width*x, box.top + box.height*y))); }; return { visibilityChecksUseHitTests: true }; })()

(() => { const list = document.querySelector('main ol'); const scroller = list.parentElement; scroller.scrollTop = scroller.scrollHeight; return { chatHasOverflow: scroller.scrollHeight > scroller.clientHeight, chatStartsAtEnd: Math.abs(scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight - scroller.scrollTop) < 1 }; })()

(() => { const actions = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button[aria-label="Copy reply"]')].at(-1); const scroller = document.querySelector('main ol').parentElement; const jump = document.querySelector('main button[aria-label="Jump to the latest message"]'); return { lastReplyActionsStayInView: actions.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= scroller.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 1, noJumpAfterWidthChange: getComputedStyle(jump).visibility === 'hidden' }; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('aside [role=tabpanel] button')].map(button => button.textContent.trim()); const compaction = rows.findIndex(row => row.startsWith('Pi compacted the chat')); const seventh = rows.findIndex(row => /^7You wrote/.test(row)); const sixth = rows.findIndex(row => /^6You wrote/.test(row)); return { compactionReadableAndReachable: window.qaVisible([...document.querySelectorAll('aside [role=tabpanel] button')].find(button => button.textContent.trim().startsWith('Pi compacted the chat'))), nearbyRequestsVisible: [6,7].every(number => window.qaVisible([...document.querySelectorAll('aside button')].find(button => button.textContent.trim().startsWith(number + 'You wrote')))), compactionRowVisible: compaction !== -1 && rows[compaction].includes('requests 1 to 4 became a summary'), compactionFollowsTurnSix: seventh !== -1 && sixth !== -1 && seventh < compaction && compaction < sixth, effortChangeVisible: document.querySelector('aside [role=tabpanel]').innerText.includes('Thinking effort set to high') }; })()

({ compactionSummaryVisible: (() => { const section = [...document.querySelectorAll('aside section')].find(section => section.querySelector('h3')?.textContent === 'Compaction'); return window.qaVisible(section) && ['Ship the plan in six steps.', 'Steps 1 to 4 are done.'].every(text => section.textContent.includes(text)); })() })
